gloss_en: How to use Name, Reference and PredefinedType/USERDEFINED so elements are identifiable when Reference is deprecated and Allplan lacks object types.
title_original: Correct Use of IFC Name and Reference (deprecated?)
question_paraphrase: In Allplan with IFC 4.3, how should I fill Name, Reference and PredefinedType/USERDEFINED? Reference is deprecated and Allplan has no object types. Put German descriptions in Name?
phrasing_notes: Architect, careful polite wording, specific attribute names, mentions vendor limitation and German-language naming.
answer_summary: Use Name for instance identification (e.g. door number such as D-01_45), Description for the descriptive label, avoid deprecated attributes, consider IFC4 instead of 4.3 if Reference needed.

gloss_en: One wall appears dislocated after Revit export to IFC4.
title_original: Revit to IFC, Wall is dislocated
question_paraphrase: exported Revit to IFC4 and one wall is dislocated; I struggle with this for a year - how to fix?
phrasing_notes: Lowercase, non-native English, signs off with KR and a name, bulleted extras.
answer_summary: Known bug for non-extrusion (voided) walls without local placement in IFC4 reference view; report on Autodesk revit-ifc GitHub; IFC2x3 avoids it.

gloss_en: Shared parameter mapped to a duct Pset Material attribute does not show up in the IFC export.
title_original: IFC mapping in Revit MEP
question_paraphrase: Hi all, new to IFC. I created a shared parameter named like the duct Pset Material attribute but it does not appear in the exported IFC. Can anyone shed some light?
phrasing_notes: Greeting, admits being new, plain description, hopeful closing.
answer_summary: No direct fix; pointed to Autodesk support and revit-ifc GitHub issues.

gloss_en: Roof does not export as IfcBuildingElementPart although walls, floors and ceilings do with Show parts.
title_original: Roof in Revit and IFCBuildingElementPart- IFC4
question_paraphrase: Testing IFC4 export from Revit 2024 with Parts Visibility 'Show parts'. Walls, ceilings, floors give parts but roof does not. Bug or did I miss something?
phrasing_notes: Brief technical query, 'or I missed something'.
answer_summary: The roof simply had not been split into parts in Revit.

gloss_en: System colors of pipes (hot red, cold blue, sewage green) are lost between Revit export and ArchiCAD.
title_original: How can I control the IFC pipes colors (Revit to ArchiCAD)

phrasing_notes: Beginner, first person, emojis, names several IFC entities from guessing.
answer_summary: Revit has long-standing colour/material export problems (linked revit-ifc issues); attach the IFC to diagnose.

gloss_en: Custom STEP parser rejects a Revit IFC file because of header timestamp, nested lists and escaped quote.
title_original: A number of interesting Revit IFC parsing errors.
question_paraphrase: My parser rejects Revit IFC for three reasons: timestamp in header, nested parentheses in list attributes, and a string ending in an escaped quote like 8''.
answer_summary: The file is valid (list of lists in IfcCartesianPointList3D, doubled quote is an escape); the bug was in the parser.

phrasing_notes: Numbered questions, careful non-native English, discloses AI assistance.
answer_summary: App state (layers, views) is not in IFC; suggested a project folder with separate files and a root IFC referencing discipline files.

gloss_en: Revit-exported IFC shows 'Opening Cuts Skipped' warning; clicking Apply Openings fixes it - bug or intended?
title_original: Opening Cuts Skipped in Bonsai Studio 0.9
question_paraphrase: G'day all, when I open IFC from Revit (and one from ArchiCAD) I get Opening Cuts Skipped; Apply Openings fixes it. Bug or intended? It did not happen in earlier versions.
answer_summary: Void Limit (max-voids-per-element) setting did not help; splitting problem elements into a separate IFC avoided it; maybe a bug.

gloss_en: How Revit converts UniqueId to IFC GlobalId so that elements can be matched across Revit and IFC.

phrasing_notes: Developer blog, first person, informal-technical Japanese with code walkthrough.
answer_summary: Revit preserves original IFC GUID, derives from UniqueId XOR ElementId, or generates fresh ones; author wrapped a conversion library.
